import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO(data))

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='model_year', 
    y='price_usd', 
    hue='sensor_type', 
    size='megapixels', 
    data=df,
    sizes=(100, 500),
    alpha=0.7
)

for _, row in df.iterrows():
    plt.text(
        row['model_year'], 
        row['price_usd'], 
        f"{row['brand']} {row['model_year']}", 
        va='bottom', 
        ha='right'
    )

plt.title('Camera Price vs Model Year (Size = Megapixels, Color = Sensor Type)')
plt.xlabel('Model Year')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
